reflexivity_response: Looking back, I think my background shapes how much I lean toward giving posts the benefit of the doubt. I grew up in a third-world country where topics like gender identity and microaggressions weren't part of everyday conversation, so I don't come to these posts with built-in alarm bells the way someone raised around that discourse might. I also wasn't exposed to movements like MeToo directly, so I read posts about it more literally, without assuming hidden intent. Overall, I think I default to taking statements at face value unless the harmful reading is obvious, rather than searching for what might be implied underneath.
